record.paper_title: Achievement sets – current results and open problems
record.original_question: Let (k_1, …, k_m; 1/n) be a multigeometric series with integer coefficients, with Σ = {σ_0 < ··· < σ_{n-1}} the set of all subsums of {k_1, …, k_m}, where |Σ| = n, none of k_1, …, k_m is divisible by n, and the achievement set E(k_1, …, k_m; 1/n) has positive Lebesgue measure. Must the residue set {t_i : σ_i ≡ t_i (mod n)} equal all residues {0,1,…,n−1}?

evidence.quote: Let (k1, . . . , km; 1/n) be a multigeometric series such that ki ∈ N, Σ = {σ0 < · · · < σn−1} has n elements, none of k1, . . . , km is divisible by n, and E(k1, . . . , km; 1/n) has positive Lebesgue measure. Is it true that the set of remainders ti < n with σi ≡ ti (mod n) equals {0, 1, . . . , n − 1}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ and $m \geq 1$ be integers, and let $k_1, \ldots, k_m$ be positive integers, none of which is divisible by $n$. Consider the sequence (the so-called multigeometric series with ratio $1/n$)
$$k_1, k_2, \ldots, k_m, \tfrac{k_1}{n}, \tfrac{k_2}{n}, \ldots, \tfrac{k_m}{n}, \tfrac{k_1}{n^2}, \tfrac{k_2}{n^2}, \ldots, \tfrac{k_m}{n^2}, \ldots$$
and define its achievement set
$$E(k_1,\ldots,k_m;1/n) = \Bigl\{ \sum_{j=1}^m k_j \sum_{i=0}^\infty \tfrac{\varepsilon_{j,i}}{n^i} : \varepsilon_{j,i}\in\{0,1\} \Bigr\},$$
i.e.\ the set of all sums of subseries of the above series. Let $\Sigma = \{\sigma_0 < \sigma_1 < \cdots < \sigma_{n-1}\}$ denote the set of all subsums of $\{k_1, \ldots, k_m\}$ (sums $\sum_{j\in J} k_j$ over $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}$), and assume that $|\Sigma| = n$, i.e.\ exactly $n$ distinct subsums occur. Assume further that $E(k_1, \ldots, k_m; 1/n)$ has positive Lebesgue measure. For each $i \in \{0,1,\ldots,n-1\}$ let $t_i \in \{0,1,\ldots,n-1\}$ be the unique residue with $\sigma_i \equiv t_i \pmod{n}$.

Question: Must one have $\{t_0, t_1, \ldots, t_{n-1}\} = \{0, 1, \ldots, n-1\}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent survey on achievement sets (December 2025). Related research on multigeometric series, Cantorvals, and conditions for positive Lebesgue measure (including recent work on Lebesgue measure of multigeometric Cantorvals and generalized multigeometric sequences) does not appear to resolve this specific residue-distribution criterion. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: The Lebesgue measure of boundaries of multigeometric Cantorvals
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (October 2025) work on Lebesgue measure properties of multigeometric Cantorvals; does not address the residue criterion.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work does not resolve the residue question.

status_evidence.title: The achievement set of generalized multigeometric sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Studies achievement sets of generalized multigeometric sequences without addressing the residue {t_i} = {0,...,n-1} question.
status_evidence.claim: Adjacent literature does not settle the problem.

status_evidence.title: On a new condition implying that an achievement set is a Cantorval
status_evidence.snippet: December 2025 paper providing new sufficient conditions for Cantorval structure of achievement sets; does not resolve the residue criterion.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on multigeometric achievement sets does not address this question.
